note: Wholeness gate DATA (W2-A, de-faced 2026-07-04). Two published-records: (1) a capability-obligation — the 'deep-work' capability is LOCKED until a walk is ATTESTED today; (2) a measure-definition that COUNTS today's walk-attestation facts. The honest loop: the Satisfy button writes a real activity.attestation fact (evidence, stamped with today's day), then dispatches progression-evaluator's action:compute-and-write-over-facts to REDUCE today's attestations into the canonical measure.fact (emit measure.walk-count-today). The gate reads that reduced measure. Because the reduction is scoped to today ($today in fact_where) AND the condition carries within_ms freshness, the gate DECAYS — it re-locks each day, which a raw measure write never did. The walk is a DATA row: ANY fact can gate ANY capability, ANY reduction, with zero new code (L069/L090).
